# aoa-evals

Route one central bounded-proof question without letting a catalog, green
command, readiness check, candidate, report, receipt, generated reader, MCP
result, or KAG node outrank its source bundle and admitted evidence.

## Applicability preflight

Before resolving the central owner, inspect only the request:

- if it asks to classify supplied or retrieved session hits against an eval
  trigger, route a local no-fit, design a local suite, or select/apply a
  repository eval, return `owner_handoff` to `aoa-eval`
- a packet being closed, reviewed, or provenance-bearing does not make it a
  central proof object
- begin this bundle only when the task already concerns central proof meaning,
  a central source bundle, a named eval result or verdict, an owner-routed
  proof object, or an `aoa-evals` lifecycle decision

Do not inspect the task workspace, search for an owner checkout, probe supplied
paths, or run `pwd`, `rg`, `find`, or `test` for navigation after this bundle
loads. Read the contract, source-return rule, and selected mode first; then use
the declared bundled resource as the first navigation action.

## Start

1. The first tool turn must read only this `SKILL.md`. Record `<bundle_dir>` as
   its absolute containing directory. If workspace inspection or search was
   combined with that read, stop the attempt and restart in a fresh invocation;
   later compliance cannot repair the unobserved package-first gate.
2. Read `references/contract.yaml` and choose exactly one internal mode:

   | Mode | Select when | Read |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | `select` | No exact central source bundle has been selected for the bounded proof need. | `references/select.md` |
   | `review` | A named central bundle, result, verdict, source-linked report, or already owner-routed proof object must be interpreted. | `references/review.md` |
   | `evolve` | The request asks to add, change, promote, supersede, or retire a central source, lifecycle, comparison, or chooser surface, even when a required gate may later block the operation. | `references/evolve.md` |

   Select by the requested operation, not by whether its gates have already
   passed. Missing review, authority, or confirmation blocks `evolve`; it does
   not turn a requested owner change into `review`.

3. Read `references/source-return.md` and only the selected mode reference to
   EOF. Do not load the other mode procedures merely because their vocabulary
   appears nearby.
4. Follow the selected procedure and return the common output ABI from
   `references/contract.yaml`.

Keep the modes internal until held-out manual work proves that splitting them
improves trigger precision, ABI, composition, and outcomes.

## Owner boundary

- Source `EVAL.md`, `eval.yaml`, and admitted evidence own proof meaning.
- This skill owns procedure only. Its source receipt, catalog, scores, reports,
  readiness surfaces, receipts, generated readers, MCP, KAG, and green checks
  remain weaker.
- Use shared `aoa-eval` for cross-repository selection, exact local
  application, owner-local no-fit intake or design, and eval-trigger
  classification of supplied or retrieved session hits. Begin here only at
  central `aoa-evals` proof meaning or an owner decision.
- Technique references are optional bundle-local lineage, never a runtime
  prerequisite.
- `select` and `review` are read-only. `evolve` may change owner source only
  with explicit authority and required human confirmation.

## Composition

Build only the task-local edges the request needs:

```text
origin need or candidate evidence
  -> source proof contract and admitted evidence
  -> execution support and reviewed result when material
  -> derived readers or consumers when material
```

`select` may hand its exact source contract to `review`; an accepted `review`
may later hand off to `evolve`. Do not force a three-stage workflow. A later
node cannot repair or strengthen an earlier source or evidence gap.

An eval candidate ID beginning with `session:` remains an `aoa-evals`
owner-routed object. Do not load session-memory guidance merely because of that
prefix. Compose with session-memory only when the task actually requires raw,
segment, session, or retrieval evidence beyond the supplied owner object.

## Stops

Stop after one selection, bounded review, authorized source-first change,
no-change result, owner handoff, or explicit blocker. Never execute an eval
inside `select`, mutate inside `review`, infer owner acceptance, or treat a
schema-valid packet or valid DAG as proof.

Keep raw trials, temporary rubrics, task-local DAGs, session notes, runtime
state, and test scaffolding outside the owner skill home.

# aoa-evals

Route one central bounded-proof question without letting a catalog, green
command, readiness check, candidate, report, receipt, generated reader, MCP
result, or KAG node outrank its source bundle and admitted evidence.

## Applicability preflight

Before resolving the central owner, inspect only the request:

- if it asks to classify supplied or retrieved session hits against an eval
  trigger, route a local no-fit, design a local suite, or select/apply a
  repository eval, return `owner_handoff` to `aoa-eval`
- a packet being closed, reviewed, or provenance-bearing does not make it a
  central proof object
- begin this bundle only when the task already concerns central proof meaning,
  a central source bundle, a named eval result or verdict, an owner-routed
  proof object, or an `aoa-evals` lifecycle decision

Do not inspect the task workspace, search for an owner checkout, probe supplied
paths, or run `pwd`, `rg`, `find`, or `test` for navigation after this bundle
loads. Read the contract, source-return rule, and selected mode first; then use
the declared bundled resource as the first navigation action.

## Start

1. The first tool turn must read only this `SKILL.md`. Record `<bundle_dir>` as
   its absolute containing directory. If workspace inspection or search was
   combined with that read, stop the attempt and restart in a fresh invocation;
   later compliance cannot repair the unobserved package-first gate.
2. Read `references/contract.yaml` and choose exactly one internal mode:

   | Mode | Select when | Read |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | `select` | No exact central source bundle has been selected for the bounded proof need. | `references/select.md` |
   | `review` | A named central bundle, result, verdict, source-linked report, or already owner-routed proof object must be interpreted. | `references/review.md` |
   | `evolve` | The request asks to add, change, promote, supersede, or retire a central source, lifecycle, comparison, or chooser surface, even when a required gate may later block the operation. | `references/evolve.md` |

   Select by the requested operation, not by whether its gates have already
   passed. Missing review, authority, or confirmation blocks `evolve`; it does
   not turn a requested owner change into `review`.

3. Read `references/source-return.md` and only the selected mode reference to
   EOF. Do not load the other mode procedures merely because their vocabulary
   appears nearby.
4. Follow the selected procedure and return the common output ABI from
   `references/contract.yaml`.

Keep the modes internal until held-out manual work proves that splitting them
improves trigger precision, ABI, composition, and outcomes.

## Owner boundary

- Source `EVAL.md`, `eval.yaml`, and admitted evidence own proof meaning.
- This skill owns procedure only. Its source receipt, catalog, scores, reports,
  readiness surfaces, receipts, generated readers, MCP, KAG, and green checks
  remain weaker.
- Use shared `aoa-eval` for cross-repository selection, exact local
  application, owner-local no-fit intake or design, and eval-trigger
  classification of supplied or retrieved session hits. Begin here only at
  central `aoa-evals` proof meaning or an owner decision.
- Technique references are optional bundle-local lineage, never a runtime
  prerequisite.
- `select` and `review` are read-only. `evolve` may change owner source only
  with explicit authority and required human confirmation.

## Composition

Build only the task-local edges the request needs:

```text
origin need or candidate evidence
  -> source proof contract and admitted evidence
  -> execution support and reviewed result when material
  -> derived readers or consumers when material
```

`select` may hand its exact source contract to `review`; an accepted `review`
may later hand off to `evolve`. Do not force a three-stage workflow. A later
node cannot repair or strengthen an earlier source or evidence gap.

An eval candidate ID beginning with `session:` remains an `aoa-evals`
owner-routed object. Do not load session-memory guidance merely because of that
prefix. Compose with session-memory only when the task actually requires raw,
segment, session, or retrieval evidence beyond the supplied owner object.

## Stops

Stop after one selection, bounded review, authorized source-first change,
no-change result, owner handoff, or explicit blocker. Never execute an eval
inside `select`, mutate inside `review`, infer owner acceptance, or treat a
schema-valid packet or valid DAG as proof.

Keep raw trials, temporary rubrics, task-local DAGs, session notes, runtime
state, and test scaffolding outside the owner skill home.

    - {kind: hands-off-to, from: review, to: evolve, abi: proof-owner-evolution-request, condition: bounded owner change pressure survives review and the task asks for mutation}
  composes-with: [aoa-eval, aoa-decision, aoa-session-memory-global-route]
  hands-off-to: [aoa-eval, origin owner, aoa-skills, aoa-memo, aoa-stats, abyss-stack, inspected stronger owner]
  conflicts-with: [green-as-proof, readiness-as-verdict, candidate-as-bundle, report-as-source, generated-as-authority, implicit-maturity-promotion]

tool_requirements:
  fixed_tool_dependency: false
  techniques_runtime_dependency: false
  bundled_read_resource: scripts/eval_contract_packet.py

termination:
  - one exact, partial, or no-fit selection
  - one bounded review disposition
  - one owner-authorized source change or no-change result
  - one owner handoff or blocker

health:
  recheck_after: [material model change, host or workflow change, source bundle or skill change]
  manual_cases: [positive trigger, negative trigger, held-out wording, coexistence, bounded effects]

# Evolve owner proof

### Mode: evolve

## Entry gates

Require a stable bounded need, accepted review or recorded duplicate/no-fit,
resolved owner, acceptance criteria, explicit effect authority, and every
human confirmation required by root `AGENTS.md`. Stop `blocked` when any gate
is missing.

## Procedure

1. Run the declared `source` command from `references/source-return.md` once.
   Read the returned owner `AGENTS.md` before judging authority or required
   human confirmation. Do not use catalog search unless comparison with source
   bundles is material to the requested evolution. Treat a `session:` candidate
   ID as an owner-routed eval object, not as a request to load session-memory;
   use session-memory only when raw or segment evidence must actually be
   retrieved.
2. Check the entry gates against the exact supplied owner sources. When the
   request forbids changes, effect authority is absent, or accepted owner
   review and required human confirmation are missing, return one bounded
   blocker after reading only the sources needed to establish those gaps. Do
   not inventory alternative bundles, run the motivating-case suite, execute
   readiness or validation commands, or draft a source change after a failed
   gate.
3. Only after every entry gate passes, decide the owner before the artifact:
   - local pressure, suites, fixtures, and reports stay in the origin repo port;
   - candidate packets and Eval Forge worksheets remain non-proof;
   - reusable central proof meaning belongs in a source eval bundle;
   - repeatable proof operations belong to their mechanic;
   - generated readers, receipts, MCP, and KAG remain derived or access layers.
4. Compare reuse, extension, a new bundle, maturity change, supersession,
   retirement, and no change. Prefer the narrowest existing owner surface that
   already answers the bounded need.
5. Manually exercise the motivating case, strongest negative, nearest competing
   bundle, evidence-gap case, and intended consumer.
6. Add permanent automation only when those cases expose a stable, long-lived
   invariant and the current task authorizes the write. Do not create a
   validator to make an unresolved trial look green.
7. When authorized, change owner source before generated companions. Rebuild
   only declared projections, inspect the actual source and outputs, and state
   what green checks do not prove.
8. Otherwise return an owner-ready bounded proposal, `no_change`, handoff, or
   blocker. Do not silently broaden the effect.

## Verification and stop

Report the exact source change, actual effects, manual cases, generated
companions rebuilt, skipped checks, claim limit, rollback posture, and next
owner. Stop after one bounded owner decision or source-first change.

# Review bounded proof

### Mode: review

## Required input

Require an exact source bundle or owner-routed proof object, the material
evidence/report/verdict/pressure, and enough repository, environment, baseline,
freshness, and review posture to interpret it. Route an unselected central need
to `select`.

## Procedure

1. Run the one declared command from `references/source-return.md` before any
   workspace or owner-path inspection. For an exact candidate packet ID, with
   or without an exact owner-review report path, this must be `review-context`;
   otherwise use `source`. Read the returned root owner `AGENTS.md`, then only
   the exact material paths returned by the packet or supplied beneath that
   owner root. Read-only evidence inspection is not an edit to those paths: do
   not enumerate or load their edit-route `AGENTS.md` cards. Do not use catalog
   search when the request already names the reviewed object. When citations
   are needed, read each exact document with line numbers on the first pass.
2. Read source `EVAL.md` and `eval.yaml` before any report, dashboard, receipt,
   MCP result, KAG node, or generated reader only when the selected object has
   an explicit accepted source-bundle link. When a candidate has no such link,
   keep that absence explicit; do not probe the skill package or substitute or
   search for a neighboring eval bundle. An unrelated source bundle cannot
   raise the candidate's proof state.
3. Read every material evidence ref and the actual named report or artifact.
   Preserve repository revision, model, host, tools, fixture, environment,
   baseline, accepted exits, scorer, and human review posture.
4. Distinguish each state explicitly:
   - source-contract readiness;
   - execution success;
   - evidence acceptance;
   - report validity;
   - bounded verdict;
   - public maturity;
   - central proof admission.

   No state implies the next.
5. For maturity, comparison, publication, or Eval Forge pressure, read
   `docs/guides/EVAL_FORGE_READINESS_LAYER.md` and the exact named owner-review
   report. Read implementation scripts only when their behavior is itself
   under review. Require the bundle-local evidence kind and explicit human
   confirmation named by root owner law. A green integrity sidecar cannot
   promote its neighbor. Do not inspect neighboring reports, dashboards,
   candidate reviews, or generated readers unless the named source or artifact
   cites one and it can materially change the disposition.
   Reading a readiness contract does not authorize its commands. Run a
   readiness check, route command, validator, generator, or test only when the
   request asks about current operational execution/readiness or when the
   source contract makes that result material to the bounded verdict. A
   contract-level proof-authority question normally needs no command execution.
6. Replay the strongest overread or evidence-gap directly from the inspected
   source and artifact. Once a missing source link, evidence acceptance,
   required human confirmation, or other gate makes every higher disposition
   impossible, stop expanding weaker surfaces. State which exact source or gate
   would change the disposition.
7. Return the narrowest supported review disposition and proof ceiling. Do not
   modify source, chooser, status, baseline, or generated readers.

## Claim limit

Review can establish only the bounded disposition supported by the inspected
source contract, accepted evidence, environment, scorer, artifact, and review
trail. Missing or weaker layers remain explicit.

# Select a central eval

### Mode: select

## Required input

Require one bounded proof question, object under evaluation, claim class,
acceptance target, and known evidence or comparison posture. Return
`blocked_missing_input` rather than inventing a missing material field.

## Procedure

1. Classify the disputed inference before searching:

   | Disputed inference | Claim class |
   | --- | --- |
   | one true local check or path signal is widened into an overall outcome | outcome-vs-path separation |
   | executed, skipped, blocked, or inferential checks are reported falsely | verification truthfulness |
   | full scope, verification, and reporting workflow is the question | composite bounded workflow |
   | requested and executed scope differ | scope alignment |
   | tool order, proportionality, omissions, or churn are the question | tool trajectory |
   | a checkpointed inquiry cannot honestly restart | long-horizon restart fidelity |

2. Normalize the claim class and object into three to eight short English terms.
   Start with the literal semantic terms of the chosen class from the table:
   for example, `outcome path separation`, `verification truthfulness`, or
   `scope alignment`. Add only material object terms after them. Do not replace
   the class terms with contextual nouns such as `local`, `validator`, `long`,
   `goal`, or `proof`, and do not use repository or expected bundle names.
3. Run exactly one bounded shortlist:

   ```text
   python <bundle_dir>/scripts/eval_contract_packet.py catalog \
     --query "<claim terms>" --limit 8
   ```

   First decide whether any returned card covers the required object and claim
   class. If so, choose one candidate and then one nearest alternative from
   that candidate's `source_neighbor_hints`; consider a lower-ranked lexical
   card only when the source hints do not cover the competing claim. Scores,
   matched terms, and hints route inspection but never establish fit.
4. Only when the result is `no_match` or lacks the required object class, make
   one fallback call:

   ```text
   python <bundle_dir>/scripts/eval_contract_packet.py catalog
   ```

   Ignore neighbor hints from an inapplicable card until after this fallback.
   Do not issue a second lexical query. Do not scan the eval tree or read
   `EVAL_SELECTION.md` unless chooser drift is itself the task.
5. Fetch the direct owner contracts for the candidate and nearest alternative:

   ```text
   python <bundle_dir>/scripts/eval_contract_packet.py contracts \
     --name <candidate> --name <neighbor>
   ```

   Pass exactly the candidate and one nearest alternative. Use the returned
   source manifest and source sections. Expand a source file only if the packet
   explicitly lacks a material field.
6. Compare object, bounded claim, trigger boundary, maturity, baseline, inputs,
   execution/report contract, blind spots, owner, and proof ceiling. Reject the
   nearest tempting alternative explicitly.
7. Return `exact_fit`, `partial_fit`, or `no_fit`. Do not execute an eval,
   scaffold a new one, change maturity, or mutate an owner surface.

## Claim limit

Selection proves only that one inspected source contract is the strongest
bounded fit among the compared candidates. It does not prove the claim,
execution, report, general agent reliability, or catalog completeness.

# Owner source return

Use the bundled read-only resource as the only ordinary source-return path.
Choose the command by task; `<mode>` is not a literal or universal placeholder.

- For `select`, run `catalog`; it returns `owner_source`. Then run `contracts`
  for one or two exact candidates. Do not run `source` separately.
- For `review` of a named candidate packet, resolve the owner, packet, and its
  single packet-declared manual-review report in one call:

  ```text
  python <bundle_dir>/scripts/eval_contract_packet.py review-context \
    --packet-id <exact-packet-id>
  ```

  When the request also supplies an exact owner-relative report path, add
  `--report <exact-owner-relative-report-path>` and require that report instead
  of deriving it from the packet's own refs.

  Read only the returned material paths. Do not run `source` separately, probe
  guessed `EVAL.md` paths, enumerate route cards, or search for the packet.
- For `review` or `evolve` when no catalog packet is needed, resolve the owner
  exactly once:

  ```text
  python <bundle_dir>/scripts/eval_contract_packet.py source
  ```

`<bundle_dir>` is the absolute directory containing the loaded `SKILL.md`.
Do not probe `--help` when one of these declared command shapes applies.
Do not inspect the task workspace or supplied owner-relative paths before the
declared command resolves the owner.

The resource resolves and validates exactly one source route:

- an installed copy uses its same-bundle `.aoa-skill-source.json`;
- the canonical owner home uses its own `skills/port.manifest.json`;
- direct maintenance may pass an explicit absolute `--owner-root`.

Every command verifies owner `aoa-evals`, bundle `skills/aoa-evals`, the owner
manifest, safe paths, and required owner files before returning data. Its
`owner_source` object reports the route, owner root, source path, and available
ref, version, digest, and dirty posture. `source` returns no selection,
evidence acceptance, verdict, or change authority.

`review-context` additionally resolves one exact packet ID and exactly one
manual-review report. Without `--report`, that report must be a safe,
owner-relative `*.manual-review.md` ref declared by the packet itself; zero or
multiple matching refs are terminal and require an exact report path. The
command returns their exact owner-relative paths and direct candidate route
fields, and reports whether the packet itself carries an explicit source-bundle
link. It remains a navigation packet; the returned owner files retain meaning.

If source resolution fails, stop as `blocked_missing_owner_source`. Do not
search parents, siblings, workspaces, `.system`, another skill copy, or a
conventional checkout. Do not retry through another source route.

Treat the source receipt, ref, digest, dirty posture, catalog score, and
neighbor hints as provenance or navigation only. They do not prove installed
parity, semantic fit, eval execution, report validity, maturity, or a verdict.

Report the returned source route and strongest owner files used. Resolve every
owner-relative path beneath the returned owner root.
